## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] Every commit is signed off with `git commit -s` ([DCO](https://github.com/itillema/0cular/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin)).
- [ ] `just check` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and the docs are updated where behavior changes.
- [ ] A change to a design decision comes with an ADR in `docs/adr/`.
